reviews.review_description: Company went bust, no decent communication until the unit failed. Costing us a fortune. Have not saved a cent.
Was a very good experience and the whole process was made fairly easy
Good interactive design and quote process, prompt replies to queries and install completed as scheduled.

Competitive price and keep up to their word in pricing. Installation dates well communicated and changes communicated in a timely manner . Customer friendly. However, I would suggest itâ€™s good to give a call back and enquire a week later after the installation and to keep customers happy.Pro-active ness in customer relation could improve.

Good installation, done in one day. Made some suggestions with customer service which they very openly took up about texting what time the installers will show up, and giving direction about how and who to complete payment to. Still just waiting to organize the wifi so the system can be monitored from the phone app, and will see the savings on out bill soon!

The sales and quoting process was very informative. When it come to the installation day the guys turned up bright and early. Very friendly and professional. Answered all of my questions and showed me how everything worked.The installers called me the next day to see if I had any questions and again a week later to see if everything was good. Can't recommend these guys enough!

Extremely happy with every aspect of service.Salesperson knowledgeable but not pushy.Quote clear and detailed.Kept up to date with progress along the way.Installers friendly, explained system fully, assisted with setting up registration and cleaned up throughly.
Good system, great customer service,Installation all went as planed & connected to grid.
When Leon came, he explained me about a solar system both sides such as merits and demerits.
Sales rep was great, he was very helpful, remaining service was professional

The salesman from the company I chose was very knowledgeable and was the only one to get on the roof to inspect the old system which was to be replaced. Only two of the salespeople came to the house, the third gave a proposal over the phone and email.Installation was on time and quick with multiple people working. They also took the old system away.All admin around connection was organised by the customer service team.

Mark came and explained the syste...he was professional and knowledgeable.Main reason I went with Lumak is down to Mark.Installers came and did the job in a day...very polite,tidy and helpful.Only issue I had was a delay in getting Ergon the EWR and from install to getting the system running took a month.However it is running well and I am happy.Should have done this years ago.

Very Laid back sales process, no pressure, in fact had fun.The guys turned up earlier than expected an got on with the job immediately, worked very tidily and were super easy to get along with.Grid connection all organised just waiting for Ergon to do their bit.

With Solar, we're not scared of having aircon during a hot day in Cairns. Lumax's sales staff was amazing. Max educated us well and answered our all our questions. We were impressed with Jamie who contacted us personally on the day he installed it. The after sales staff was great with follow up as well. Thank you Lumax Solar!

22/8/19 Luke quoted on job12/11/19 Lumax installed 21 of 22 panels. Tariff 33 not all disconnected. They did connect us to the grid.20/12/19 Many phone calls later, got Leon on site. 22nd panel still in the warehouse!16/1/20 Received Electricity bill from Ergon  No record of Solar connection?17/1/20 Several hours on phone to Ergon & Lumax. Our paperwork was submitted with the wrong address!22/1/20 Ergon received correct paperwork but didn't recognize our solar credit for previous 2Â½ months. Formal complaint lodged.30/1/20 22nd panel installed, Tariff 33 disconnections completed.10/2/20 After numerous phone calls between Ergon and Lumax, finally granted some Pro rata solar credit.5Â½months, countless phone calls & excuses, extreme stress, we think the saga is now over.
Would have been nice to hear from the firm following the install, but nothing, not even a call to check if we were happy, which we were.
They even managed to get me in earlier than booked.  Installers very proficient and speedy.
Just had system installed. Lumax staff were very helpful and and easy to deal with from start to finish.
Good staff and service.

Installation staff are very knowledgeable, take the time to explain it in full to you and leave everything as tidy as they find it.  Lovely fellows.  Would very highly recommend Lumax to other prospective solar customers.
Fantastic sales service follow up and after sales service
Everyone was so great and helpful. Fantastic work.
Fantastic system and Price. The communication for the office was great and i would recommend Lumax to anyone.  5* service from the end to the beginning.  Thanks guys...

The Townsville floods got in the way of our install but the delay wasn't an issue for me. Dean was very good at keeping up communication. The installation team were great to do a site assessment and then place the panels in a more difficult location for them to keep a fussy homeowner happy! Very glad to have used Lumax for my solar needs and happy to recommend them to others.
Good communications from installer to sales let me know of times and date of install and back up service was also good and helping.

During the last few months we have been bombarded with solar offers by pop up ads on our phones and internet and even snail mail. We have received unsolicited email offers as well as what seems to be endless array TV ads. It was easy to lose the quotes your suppliers gave us in all the "noise". However, the eventual supplier was the only one that visited my house and explained the system to us. As I was expecting this offer, I was actually looking for his companies emailed quote.

The two men that came here and were gentlemen. They got on with the job and had it done in no time. They didn't stand around, just knew what to do. Cant fault anything, cleaned up after they had finished.
Excellent friendly helpful staff, nice clean job done with no fuss.I Highly recommend Lumax Solar.
Not installed as yet
Great customer service from the sales person all the way through to installation. Would recommend to anyone who is looking at getting a solar system for their house!
great service installers were very good arrived on time no rubbish left behind would recommend this service
Not to be installed till next week weather permitting

Installation looks neat and professional. Installers cleaned up after themselves. Lumax did all the paperwork with Ergon. I chose a non-China inverter and am very pleased with the ABB system installed. Installers arrived ontime and completed the work in the one day. I am very happy with the work done and would recommend Lumax to anyone.

After using SOLAR QUOTES(great site), Lumax solar was the first company to call me back. WOW, Service was second to none at the start. Mark the salesman was great and talked the company up. Mark needs a pay rise! Installation guys turn up early and over two days installed the system.After sales service has been slow and many e-mails and calls to the office too get the job completed. I was a happy customer after 5 weeks waiting. Thanks Daniel & Mark. Happy with my solar system, hope after sales service gets better in the future.

Extremely polite and professional from the first phone call to the end of the job. The Lumax team provided a quality product to suit my budget, and their installers were excellent.Highly reccomend the company.

An excellent project from start to finish - sales with adjustments were well managed, communications were at the fore front all the time. The install team were in, cleaned up, then out after completion, very efficient. It was kinda cool to have a project run through with only a couple of oopsies, but nothing unsolvable, if the system delivers as planned  will be a great investment. Thanks & do recommend Lumax as a good experience.

The service was excellent, phone calls were returned in a timely manner, they were very knowledgeable about process and product and were happy to take the time to answer my husband's many questions. There was no hard sell and they just made the whole experience easy. They kept us informed as to what was to happen next and that is what did happen. I would highly recommend Lumax and their staff to anyone considering the addition of solar panels to their home.

These guys are very competitive. After 6 different quotes they came out on top, and delivered within 3 weeks! They are quick to respond to phone calls and emails and give detailed feedback. Installation was done very quick for a big system, and quality of installation was brilliant., and that comes from being a leko myself. Keep up the great work Lumax and team.
The staff were very accommodating, every single one that I dealt with.
The installation crew were fantastic. Their work is neat and tidy. A real pleasure to have these tradesmen working on my place.

The Company salesperson was very professional and knowledgeable of his product.The installation team were very courteous and professional in their approach to the job at hand.  They communicated well and left the site clean and tidy.  They were clear in their information of what happens next with regards to the energy provider.The office staff were very helpful with any questions asked and responded quickly with answers.
Well mannered, highly professional installers, who arrived on time, efficiently installed the ordered panels, and after leaving, had cleaned the work site. Highly recommended.
Great work from these guys, they were on time and great to talk to . very friendly service and talking me through the whole process of installation.would highly recommend this company.

Thank you to the team at Lumax Solar for your prompt service and installation of our system. We were impressed with both the sales and the installers. Lumax have been great through the whole process. They provided friendly and professional advice, they weren't pushy. I've only had the system running for a couple of days now but it seems to be working well. Communication between all parties has been excellent.  The installation team was prompt, actually asking if they could do the install a day earlier than scheduled and they  were courteous and left the place clean and tidy.The only problem has been with the Fronius WiFi and even their IT tech gave up in the end.

Once the contract was signed we fell off the radar. The Installer was great even though we had to reschedule the install due to weather and then on the appointed day we even got a call from the installer to say he was 30 mins away. Unheard of level of service in these parts. Anyway upon arrival and after determining panel layout it was discovered that the panel fixing tie downs sent by the Lumax supplier were for a Tile Roof and not a Zincalume roof. A wasted day. We rescheduled the install and this was completed on the 9th October. We were informed by the installer that the system could not be turned on until Ergon Energy had been to install the Digital Meter and to sign off on the solar install. Well after a week and no Ergon in sight I called the 131046 customer service number and after a long wait I was advised that the required Form A had not been submitted. I rang the local Lumax rep who advised by voice message that he no longer answered his phone and that callers should send a text or email. I called the installer and he resubmitted the Form A. After another week I again rang Ergon and was advised that the Form A had been received and the work order was to be scheduled. The next day I received a voicemail confirming a work order had been submitted but no indication when the work would be done. It is now November 2 and no sign of Ergon and no contact from Lumax to see how our Solar System is working. I am unable to tell you anything about the Lumax Solar as it has never been turned on for longer than 10 mins to test it was working.Is it a good quality system, does it live up to the sales blurb, will it cut my electricity costs by the much spruiked amount I honestly cannot say
Lumax was easy to deal with, just busy as everyone seems to be at the moment.  Still waiting on paperwork on system from the office but office girl says she will get it out to us at some stage.

LUMAX SOLAR WERE GREAT WITH CUSTOMER SERVICE,PRODUCT AND PRICE. THEY TURNED UP ON TIME,WERE FRIENDLY,RANG WHEN THEY SAID THEY WERE GOING TO. TICKED ALL THE BOXES FOR US, SO PLEASE DON'T HESITATE AND GIVE THEM A CALL!

To have your system registered and obtain the benefit of unused solar generated power Ergon need to come and do a site inspection of the installation but with the limited number of resources and personnel they have available it will be at least 4 weeks before it can be done. While you may be keen to use your system and gain the benefit Ergon totally let the whole procedure down and as there is no competition you are at their mercy. If there were alternative providers available Ergon would certainly get the flick. Lumax Solar were absolutely fantastic from start to finish in all aspects of the install.

From the first time we contacted LUMAX it was clear to us that this was a quality team with quality staff.The installation team were just as professional and obliging. The work was neat and clean.We recommend them to anyone who appreciates quality and service.

Not being in the location of the install made it a little difficult to make decisions on something you can't see. Company not very informative with date the install was happening. I was told one date and the install happened the day before, I got a call when they were 40 minutes out to inform me they were on their way. Tenants complained the date they were told was to be two weeks before it actually happened and messed them around waiting for something that didn't happen.Passage of information was their worst fault.
Took the time to come and have a look physically also very helpful, informative and professional. thank you
We are not sure about the product as we havenâ€™t changed over to solar yet. Carole

So helpful and very pleasant to deal withAnswered all my questions without pushy sales gimmicksNumerous follow up phone callsAll this and they still had the best priceInstallation was on time and done without any problemsHighly recommend Lumax Solar for their fast , proffesional and caring servicePeter & Leesa

Went with Lumax because they listened to what i wanted. Other companies tried pushing their products and didnt listen to what i wanted.And no pushy sales.Very impressed with both the sales and the installers.Highly recommended

Throughout the whole process from quote to installation, everyone we have dealt with at Lumax has been  very professional. Lumax was recommended to us and we would have no hesitation in recommending Lumax to others.

Lumax took the longest to get the quote to me but they were moving office at the time all in all Leon and His office staff were the most helpful in helping me select the right solar system with best price and warranty the other 2 quotes were ok but Lumax was the best at the time the system will be installed on the 14th Feb.
Chris the installer is professional and a great guy.Luke well educated and informative. Helped us navigate the solar world. Caroline very friendly. Thank you guys.
Very easy and helpful company to deal with. Great advice and kept us in the loop during the whole process.

Lumax have been great through the whole process. They provided friendly and professional advice, they weren't pushy.  I've only had the system running for a couple of days now but it seems to be working well.  The installation was prompt and the installers were tidy and courteous.  So far so good and at this stage can't fault Lumax Solar.

From the first contact with this company they were very friendly and helpful.  They kept us informed during the whole process.  Luke who was the only representative that came to our house to discuss the installation and explain everything was very knowledgeable.  All the other companies and there were a few just gave quotes by email and that was that just pay a deposit and we will be there, which I thought was very unprofessional. Luke took his time to explain in detail every aspect of the solar panels and inverter and how they work.  The day of installation the guys turned up on time and finished on schedule and cleaned up and left no mess behind. It was working perfectly when they left.  I can highly recommend this company to anyone who is thinking about installing a solar system.
Office, very helpful and a pleasure to deal with. The installers were very neat, helpful and professional. System seems to be working very well, time will tell on cost savings.

I went through an add on facebook and Lumax Solar were the only company to actually contact me and send a rep to our house. Everything was well explained and there was no pressure to buy.Installer was very professional and arrived early which was great. Panels look great!
Have had 3 different installation dates - hopefully it will be 1st December.
Just waiting on Ergon to do the meter. Then check the results online
Very professional installation, very good to deal with and provided very good products at competitive price, highly recommended

Extremely happy with Lumax Solar from the original email to the final installation. Very easy to deal with throughout the whole process, and ready to help with any questions. The day of installation the team arrived ahead of time, left our place spotless and very high standard of workmanship. Couldnt be happier.
Quote was $6,600 including a brand new meter box to QLD standards to support the solar as we had a 1960-70 type with fuses not safety switches.
He said system would be installed in 2 to 3 weeks but it will be nearly 2 months before it is operating. They are blaming Ergon and vice versa.

Lumax (based in Cairns) outsourced the installation to a local Townsville provider (Lollo and Allan). Communication between the two was poor at times eg.installed the wrong inverter, but did rectify the error. The new inverter was installed while we were away, still haven't had anyone come and provide any info on how to read/understand or download data remotely. Was also supposed to receive some pack of information (according to their emails), but nothing has arrived. Also received nil info on whether Ergon has been contacted. Job was finished 3 weeks ago. Installation work was neat and completed in a day.
The salesman office staff and installers were absolutely brilliant, extremely happy with the whole deal

One was actually significantly cheaper for the same system and their communication was also excellent. Lumax was also excellent in every aspect of the process - finally we felt that because our local Warwick economy is struggling at the moment the thought of supporting a local family appealed to my wife and I.

Cancelled installation twice the first time installer changed date without telling anyone then second time cancelled the day before it was supposed to happen finally completed on the last attempt finished within half a day

I found Lumax very good to deal with any question I had was answered immediately. Any concerns I had was dealt with in the appropriate manner.Lumax were the only company that offered a contact person to come to our house& to discuss the systems available to us & which one would be most suitable to our location & power usage.

The installation was very quick, (about 5 hours) but is very well done with a neat and professional finish. We have no areas to complain about as everything was done as it was supposed to. The system is now connected and working and so far is providing abut 3 times our daily usage so it is pretty well negating our power usage costs and we are still in winter with the sun low in the sky. Overall we are very happy with the entire process, the finished job and the final outcome. Can't say much more than that.

Lumax provided top notch customer service and they worked with us to get our wants/needs met. We now have an excellent upgraded photovoltaic system. We love the Fronius inverter and meter for monitoring the system.
VERY HAPPY WITH THE INSTALLATION AND THE OVER ALL LOOK OF THE SOLAR PANELS..

Thankyou team Lumax Solar. Excellent customer service from the ladies on reception to the sales rep Martin and the three guys who installed our solar system, couldn't ask for better service.we would recommend Lumax Solar to anyone wishing to instal solar panels on their roof.

I did not have a good understanding of solar systems, or products but after speaking to luke the sales rep I feel I understood enough to make an informed decision.We decided on a system that suited our needs. The installer chis came on the saturday morning at an agreed time, he was very efficient and new exactly what he was doing. He was very helpful and answered any questions we had.

Lumax sales person Luke was awesome he sat down and explained everything in detail so wr could understand the workings of the whole system.  We found that a lot of companies were just interested in selling there packages but not taking the time to sit and discuss everything ftom the purchase to the installation snd how to understand the importance of the contents of the solar package.So if your hunting for a solar system hit these guy's up first as you will not be disappointed.
Very prompt

After everything was finished and up and running, their 'tech guy' Leon has proved rather hard to access.I'm sure if we complained, he would but........We needed more time/ input/ discussion about the placing of the panels ....... as it turns out that they should actually be on the western side - rather than the Eastern.If we had more time and input - and knew what questions to ask! - we would have insisted on Western installation.We are late risers and did not realise how quickly production would drop after mid-day........We didn't know what 'we didn't know' - if you see?!
Any problems they were right on to it

Communication with us the customer great.Installation staff and sales rep punctual.Everything that was promised was delivered.Despite difficult weather conditions the job was carried out speedily and finished within expected time frame.

Overall the experience was very good but I hope the guys at Lumax learnt from their experience with me. Communication and punctuality are key when dealing with customers. Remember, their time matters too.

Everything I have experienced with this company and their installers is quality and professional. I feel more confident that we have a safe and efficient system having chosen quality over price. The friendly knowledgable 2 man installation team put in long hot hours on the roof to get it right. Very happy wih our choice to get solar through Lumax.
Great people to deal with, great service, seamless process, would highly recommend.
Leon was very helpful and knowledgeable.  I believe the system decided upon was the best fit and value for our needs.  Very nice job on the installation.

Thank you to the team at Lumax Solar for your prompt service and installation of our system. The product looks really aesthetic with the roof line of our home. The installation team demonstrated their impeccable service, customer care and consideration to our neighbours whilst completing the installation on the weekend. We are nowing looking forward to experiencing cooler summer days and savings on our energy bills.
